---
name: Bug report
about: Report a bug in PluginVault
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
A clear, concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open PluginVault
2. Click '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happened.

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.2, Windows 11]
- PluginVault version: (see Settings → About)
- Plugin library size: approximate number of plugins

## Screenshots / logs
If applicable, add screenshots. For crashes, include logs from:
- macOS: `~/Library/Logs/com.pluginvault.app/`
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\com.pluginvault.app\logs\`

## Did the bug affect plugin files?
If yes, please include the SQLite database file (`pluginvault.db`) — it contains toggle history that can help recover the situation.
- macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/com.pluginvault.app/pluginvault.db`
- Windows: `%APPDATA%\com.pluginvault.app\pluginvault.db`
